name: cf-browser
description: A shared Cloudflare Browser Run browser: persistent logins, independent agent tabs, interactive Live View and verified cleanup when work finishes.

account_id.title: Cloudflare account ID
account_id.description: The 32-character account ID (dashboard: Account home → the ID next to the account name). Or leave empty and put CF_ACCOUNT_ID in ~/.cf-browser/.env.

api_token.title: Cloudflare API token (Browser Run Edit)
api_token.description: An API token with the Browser Run Edit/Write permission for this account. Stored in the OS keychain. Or leave empty and put CF_API_TOKEN in ~/.cf-browser/.env.

default_profile.title: Everyday profile
default_profile.description: The profile new browsers load and save logins to by default.

profiles_dir.title: Profiles folder
profiles_dir.description: Where saved logins live. Outside the plugin's data folder on purpose, so uninstalling keeps them; delete the folder to forget every login.

idle_timeout_seconds.title: Close idle browsers after (seconds)
idle_timeout_seconds.description: Release forgotten idle agent tasks after this interval. Running operations and human control remain active.

open_live_view_locally.title: Open Live View in your browser
open_live_view_locally.description: Open the local shared-browser control panel in your default browser.
